- Proven ability to bring structure to complex or evolving programs through integrated project plans, governance routines, RAID management, stakeholder forums, milestone tracking, and executive reporting.

- Exposure to FIX protocol, execution logs, and connectivity behaviour in APAC venue environments.

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills; comfortable working with large order and execution data sets.
